payload.rationale: As of September 19, 2026, exactly three months before the scheduled December 18, 2026 release, the official website for Dune: Part Three is actively advertising this date and specific early-access screenings. At this late stage in the production and marketing cycle, a major delay is highly unlikely, as theater bookings and promotional commitments are typically locked in. The strongest reason this estimate could be too high is that the film is only three months away with concrete early access dates, which almost always indicates a locked picture and finalized distribution. The strongest reason this estimate could be too low is that unforeseen post-production VFX bottlenecks, sudden studio strategic shifts, or external events could still force a last-minute delay, and the presence of placeholder text on the official site might hint at minor behind-the-scenes delays in marketing.
limitations: An advertised schedule is not proof of completed post-production or a guarantee against delay. Some character sections contain placeholder text.
